items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: With Lucille Achet, see. She was supposed to come up some -- maybe some while later, you know. She was maybe a year or so -- she was going to come up and join us, travel sometime with us, you know.

ctx.x: Well, when was the next time that you started tap dancing again really? I mean you danced on the street, you say, for coins then, but then what was the next break you had as introduction?
Well, it was Miss Lucille Achet, this lady had the record shop. She was telling me about her father was going to go to New York, see. And it was time for that.
